# Verified source directory — Passage Prep

Checked: 2026-10-11. This is a **navigation directory**, not a mirror of any publisher's content. The paths listed are starting points for future passage-specific searches. Check the actual current contents and speaker/scripture before relying on a hit; catalog availability and transcripts can change.

**Routing rule:** Search the named official/canonical archives first. If the user names a specific person, do not silently substitute a different speaker. Discovering a *sermon listing* does not prove a *full transcript*. Prioritize exact passage, then surrounding passage, then thematic support, always labeled.

## How availability is recorded

- **TEXT** = substantial full text or original manuscript is visible for at least some entries.
- **OUTLINE** = publisher provides sermon outline / teaching notes, not necessarily full transcript.
- **AUDIO/VIDEO** = official hosted recording; timestamping is possible only with verified synchronization.
- **VARIES / CHECK** = coverage differs across items and dates.
- **THIRD-PARTY TRANSCRIPT** = potentially helpful discovery aid, **not** canonical proof; verify a named quotation/example against original recording before including it.
- **PUBLIC DOMAIN ORIGINAL** = old underlying author text, subject to translation/edition verification.

Do not try to search every source exhaustively for every passage. Search the explicit trusted roster in the order below; stop when 2–5 usable messages from genuinely different speakers provide good coverage. Record missing matches, without inventing a match or defaulting to thematic detours.

---

## A. Sermon Workshop — explicitly named/approved speakers

### 1. John Piper
- **Official primary index:** https://www.desiringgod.org/messages
- **Scripture-index pattern:** `https://www.desiringgod.org/scripture/{bible-book-slug}/messages` (e.g., https://www.desiringgod.org/scripture/john/messages). Do not assume a constructed book slug works; verify or use site navigation.
- **Actual source pages:** https://www.desiringgod.org/messages/blessed-are-the-poor-in-spirit-who-mourn
- **Availability:** strong **TEXT**, frequently AUDIO/VIDEO.
- **Search route:** scripture-index > exact verse / nearby unit > open a message > verify author **John Piper**. Desiring God also publishes David Mathis and other authors; do not attribute their writing to Piper.
- **Copyright:** contemporary ministry text, not open-source/public-domain. Quote sparingly.

### 2. David Platt
- **Official primary message archive:** https://radical.net/message/
- **Official podcast transcripts:** https://radical.net/podcasts/radical-podcast/
- **Verified transcript example:** https://radical.net/message/faith-submits/
- **Availability:** excellent **TEXT** on many older sermons; some have downloadable notes and transcripts, plus AUDIO/VIDEO.
- **Search route:** search `site:radical.net/message/ "<reference>" "David Platt"` and `site:radical.net/podcasts/radical-podcast/ "<reference>"`, then verify heading, passage and visible transcript.
- **Caveat:** podcast sermons, recap excerpts and thematic material are not interchangeable. Verify true primary text before mapping the entire sermon.

### 3. Josh Howerton — Lakepointe Church
- **Identity:** current Lakepointe senior pastor associated with the user's reference to "Lake Point pastor."
- **Official church message library:** https://lakepointe.church/messages/
- **Official digital/podcast hub:** https://lakepointe.church/digital/
- **Availability:** mostly **AUDIO/VIDEO**; site message library is an embedded content feed and does not reliably expose a readable official transcript.
- **Optional discovery (independent, not official):** https://spoken.md/podcast/lakepointe-church-with-josh-howerton-1459658332 lists third-party transcribed podcast episodes; access may require account/credits, and cannot stand alone for verification.
- **Search route:** church messages / official podcast title + passage first; then test whether original video has trustworthy captions. Search episodes independently by exact passage. Only write a full map if content is actually accessible; otherwise give a listen/watch link.

### 4. Derwin L. Gray — Transformation Church
- **Official message archive:** https://transformationchurch.tc/sermons/
- **Example:** https://transformationchurch.tc/sermons/derwin-gray-tc-welcomes-2026/
- **Availability:** **OUTLINE** and conversation guides on many sermon pages, plus **AUDIO/VIDEO**. A publisher-provided outline is not a verbatim sermon transcript.
- **Search route:** church message archive > specific passage/series > confirm that **Derwin Gray** preached the specific installment (guest preachers also listed) > use outline to map declared structure; only give narrative illustrations if video/transcript confirms them.
- **Special value:** many ready-made sermon outlines help investigate how he structures and applies the passage.

### 5. Philip Anthony Mitchell — 2819 Church
- **Official church source:** https://2819church.org/
- **Official church podcast:** https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/2819-church/id1788235375
- **Official YouTube channel:** use the official 2819 Church videos via its site, podcast, or linked channel; check author/series/passage for each message.
- **Independent discovery/index (NOT represented as official or verified):** https://2819vault.com/ indexes 2819 videos and Scripture topics.
- **Potential third-party timestamped transcripts (verify against official recording):** https://www.tapesearch.com/podcast/2819-church/1788235375
- **Availability:** predominantly **AUDIO/VIDEO**; full official text is not consistently confirmed. External automated transcripts may be noisy.
- **Search route:** official series/YouTube title and Scripture > audio/podcast > video captions if verifiable. Mark delivery/emphasis/illustrations only if personally observed in full recording or reliable exact transcription.
- **Do not:** claim to have extracted vocal tone, a dramatic pause, or story specifics from title/summary alone.

### 6. Francis Chan — Crazy Love Ministries
- **Official passage-searchable message library:** https://www.crazylove.org/messages
- **Official item example:** https://www.crazylove.org/messages/918
- **Availability:** substantial **AUDIO/VIDEO** archive, searchable by topics, series and Scripture; official page summaries do not necessarily include full transcripts.
- **Supplementary independent transcript index (NOT authoritative):** https://www.greatchurchtools.com/sermons/pastor/8/pastor-francis-chan

### 7. Timothy Keller — Gospel in Life
- **Official sermon archive:** https://gospelinlife.com/sermons/
- **Availability:** large catalog searchable by Scripture, speaker, topic, and year; **AUDIO** is widespread. Full-text manuscripts/transcripts are **NOT routinely provided** on every entry.
- **Search route:** official site Scripture filters > exact passage > open sermon listing > check for player/transcript/notes. If only audio, offer listening link and do not invent a structural outline.
- **Rights:** modern copyrighted work. A sermon being free to stream does not mean it can be reproduced.
- **Important:** don't overclaim full searchable transcript coverage just because the archive indexes >2,000 messages.

### 8. Jim Cymbala — Brooklyn Tabernacle
- **Official Sunday sermon video library:** https://media.brooklyntabernacle.org/sunday_media
- **Official audio sermon archive:** https://media.brooklyntabernacle.org/audio_media
- **Official personal writing/devotional blog:** https://www.brooklyntabernacle.org/blog/
- **Official church website:** https://www.brooklyntabernacle.org/
- **Availability:** meaningful **AUDIO/VIDEO** archive and written devotionals, but no comprehensive official full-transcript database verified.
- **Search route:** site media search by Scripture/title/name > ensure speaker **Jim Cymbala** (other Brooklyn Tabernacle pastors appear) > use player/audio and any official caption source when available. Written article is not a transcript of a sermon.
- **Fallback:** return direct listening link; do not manufacture sermon structure or timestamped illustration.
- **Example written topic-adjacent resource:** https://www.brooklyntabernacle.org/the-joy-of-being-empty/ addresses Matthew 5:3 (not necessarily verse 4).

### 9. John Stott
- **Official archive / ministry hub:** https://johnstott.org/all-work/sermons/
- **Official personal resource site:** https://johnstott.org/
- **Availability:** selected **AUDIO/VIDEO**, not necessarily full free manuscripts.
- **Logos option, if user owns licensed resource:** https://faithlife.com/store/product/198303/john-stott-sermon-archive — over 600 audio sermons with transcripts in the Logos product; **not** a free/open-access transcript source.
- **Search route:** official archive; if needed an expressly user-provided licensed Logos export; label access limits. Treat Stott's modern books and edited editions as copyrighted (he died in 2011).

### 10. Charles H. Spurgeon
- **Searchable digitized original sermons:** https://www.spurgeon.org/resource-library/
- **Original-text archive example:** https://www.spurgeon.org/resource-library/topic-index/work/?fwp_resource_types=sermons
- **Alternate historical reading source:** https://www.ccel.org/
- **Availability:** extensive **TEXT**; 19th-century sermons are **PUBLIC DOMAIN ORIGINAL** in the U.S. (specific modern arrangements/editions still need rights checks).
- **Search route:** original text/search by verse and title, preserve lengthy permissible excerpts, highlight in original wording, map his published sermon moves in Part 2 only if actual text read.
- **Dual role:** valuable both as a Part 1 original-words reading and a Part 2 published-sermon example.

### 11. Robert Murray M’Cheyne (Robert Murray McCheyne; 1813–1843)
- **Identification:** historic Scottish minister associated with the M'Cheyne Bible reading plan.
- **Sermon collection (1863 edition):** https://archive.org/details/sermonsofrevrobe00mche (Open Library catalog https://openlibrary.org/books/OL23369113M/The_Sermons_of_the_Rev._Robert_Murray_McCheyne.)
- **Additional Remains, historic 1849 volume:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Additional_remains_of_the_Rev._Robert_Murray_M%27Cheyne,_late_minister_of_St._Peter%27s_Church,_Dundee_(microform)_-_consisting_of_various_sermons_and_lectures_delivered_by_him_in_the_course_of_his_(IA_MN5152ucmf_2).pdf
- **Availability:** historical scans, variable text/OCR quality; **PUBLIC DOMAIN ORIGINAL** (U.S. historic editions), but don't invent machine-readable excerpts if scan text can't be verified.
- **Search route:** catalog index / text of historic sermon collections by biblical reference, verify correct M'Cheyne attribution and edition. Add to Part 1 or Part 2 based on the passage and the clarity of the actual sermon text.

## B. Trusted discovery networks — not single authors

### The Gospel Coalition (TGC)
- **Sermon library:** https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/sermons/
- **D. A. Carson / Carson Digital Library:** https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/the-carson-center/sermons/
- **Availability:** broad sermon index with filters for speaker, Scripture, chapter, and topic; transcript availability **VARIES**.
- **Routing:** use TGC to **find relevant speakers and passages**. Name the actual sermon author and link to original speaker/church page when possible. Do not assign TGC texts to Piper, Keller, or Carson by default.
- **Boundary:** TGC is a collection, not theological endorsement of every item it hosts. Use pastoral and exegetical discernment.

## C. Commentary Reading Room — user-named/liked historical authors

### Thomas Watson
- **Verified Matthew 5:4 chapter:** https://www.ccel.org/ccel/watson/beatitudes.viii.html
- **Verified comfort chapter:** https://www.ccel.org/ccel/watson/beatitudes.xiii.html
- **Use:** prefer his directly relevant public-domain historic treatise extracts when available. Respect the user's positive response to Watson on the Beatitudes, but don't force him into a passage where he did not write.

### Matthew Henry
- **Original, unabridged commentary volumes:** https://ccel.org/ccel/henry/mhc
- **Matthew-to-John volume:** https://www.ccel.org/ccel/henry/mhc5.html
- **Concise abridgment (shorter backup):** https://www.ccel.org/ccel/henry/mhcc
- **Use:** unabridged first when substantive reading would help; otherwise concise edition. Preserve his original context; inspect permissions of later editorial material.

### Andrew Murray (1828–1917)
- **Project Gutenberg book:** https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/12854 (The Master's Indwelling)
- **Project Gutenberg book:** https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/26003 (Jesus Himself)
- **Project Gutenberg book:** https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/19572 (Absolute Surrender)
- **CCEL example:** https://ccel.org/ccel/murray/working.all.html (Working for God)
- **Availability:** substantial **PUBLIC DOMAIN ORIGINAL** writing in verified editions. **Important:** he is mainly a devotional/spiritual-life author here, not a verse-by-verse Bible commentary on every passage.
- **Search route:** match actual passage/citation in book text first; if no real textual correspondence, label as THEMATIC SUPPORT or omit. Avoid substituting spiritually appealing themes for sound exegesis.

### Charles Spurgeon
- See sermon entry 10. His original sermons and devotional writings may function as substantive historic texts if the specific passage is actually addressed.

### Robert Murray M’Cheyne
- See sermon entry 11. Original old sermons often provide compelling devotional/historical preaching alongside commentary; classify clearly as a sermon, not a modern scholarly commentary.

### John Stott
- See sermon entry 9. Not public domain in the United States simply because deceased; prefer short attributed extracts + original link or lawful user's Logos export.

## D. Additional provisional commentary author pool (NOT an automatic endorsement)

J. C. Ryle, Alexander Maclaren, John Calvin, Augustine, John Chrysostom, and credible book-specific exegetical writers when relevant. Modern scholars/publishers (e.g., D. A. Carson, R. T. France, Craig Blomberg, Douglas Moo, Thomas Schreiner) may aid interpretation, but modern text quotation must remain limited and copyrighted.

## E. Low-cost, high-accuracy search routine

1. Normalize passage: book, chapter, verse span; search exact and a common unit around it.
2. **Part 1:** query CCEL / Gutenberg / historic text indexes plus selected scholarly titles. Check actual matches within the relevant work before copying.
3. **Part 2:** go directly to the official URL for each approved pastor, use site's built-in Scripture search/filter if possible. Use targeted domain search only when official filtering fails, e.g., `site:radical.net/message/ "Luke 15"`. Only then use general web discovery, if needed.
4. Rank **coverage and actual source accessibility**, not popularity: a true same-passage transcript beats a famous preacher mentioning the text.
5. Build a small longlist (up to 10) and actually study only the best 2–5 full sermons. Mark other links as "listen later" rather than consuming huge media collections.
6. Group by TEXT, OUTLINE, AUDIO/VIDEO, LIMITED/UNAVAILABLE; never pretend an audio page has a transcript.
7. Prefer official sources over third-party transcript farms. If nonofficial transcript is the only text, cite original video/podcast alongside it and label transcription unverified until checked.
8. Store source records, names, passage labels, and verified *links*; do **not** cache copyrighted sermon manuscripts in this public GitHub repository.
9. If 2–5 good sermons are already found, stop discovery. Investigate extras only if there is interpretive or structural value from another preacher.

## F. Timestamps and video/audio honesty

- **Default: timestamps OFF.** They are nice-to-have, not a blocking task.
- Add a timestamp only if provided by the publisher/video chapter markers, or independently checked in the exact audio/video and aligned with the cited illustration. Time location must distinguish sermon-only clip from full service rebroadcast.
- A transcript with words but no synchronized timing does not authorize an inferred minute or a fabricated clickable link.
- YouTube deep link: original watch URL plus `&t={integer}s` when a genuine integer second is verified. Example pattern, **not** a real target: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&t=123s`. Never guess VIDEO_ID or seconds.
- Podcast websites and proprietary players may not support timestamp links; give a plain URL plus verified timestamp label if deep linking isn't supported.
- Do not process long videos solely to recover timestamps unless the user explicitly values it for that task and the media can actually be inspected.
- If time, attention, or verification is limited, give **"Opening", "Middle", "Conclusion", or the transcript's real heading** rather than numerical timestamps.
- Never claim to observe pace, emotional delivery, gestures, or vocal inflection from a text-only transcript.
- For each illustration record: source URL, page/heading or verified timestamp, what the pastor said (brief), its function in sermon, and uncertainty.

## G. Rights reminder

"Free to view" and "a free transcript" do not equal public domain. Historical underlying author texts might be public domain in the U.S.; specific translated or edited editions may not. Contemporary sermons by John Piper, David Platt, Josh Howerton, Derwin Gray, Philip Anthony Mitchell, Francis Chan, Tim Keller, Jim Cymbala, John Stott and modern TGC authors remain copyrighted unless expressly licensed. Link to these originals and give a carefully grounded structural analysis; do not clone their manuscripts into the repo or into a shared reading packet.
